defects.summary: Code reads and writes users.timezone (SELECT in findUserById, UPDATE in updateUserTimezone) but no migration in migrations/ adds the column (only 001_create_users.sql exists), so GET /me and PUT /me/timezone fail with 'column "timezone" does not exist' in every deployed database
sessionCookieSecure now defaults to false, so in production (SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE unset) the session cookie issued by issueSession is sent over plain HTTP and can be intercepted
